request.description: Verifies the PAN (`DD/MM/YYYY` date of birth) on the open application's borrower profile, then saves the name; the date of birth is only used for the PAN check. Compat layer for the current app (plan §10.3): the app sets `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=<host>/v0`. The case is the borrower's newest open application, resolved server side because the app never sends one. Removed once the app moves to `/v1`.
